facts.value: Patients in England who qualify for the weight-loss drug Mounjaro on the NHS could struggle to get it prescribed through their GP according to a report by Pulse , which shows that most local health boards have withdrawn dedicated payments for prescribing and monitoring the treatment.

facts.value: Superpower Is On Sale for Black Friday: Is the Biomarker Test and AI Health Coach Worth Buying?

facts.value: We tried Superpower's $199 membership, which tests more than 100 biomarkers – see if the blood-testing service is worth trying. Biomarker blood tests are booming right now. Superpower is among the companies that offer blood testing, and the brand says its labs “go five times deeper than regular bloodwork, testing 100+ biomarkers for early signs of 1,000+ conditions.” Founded in 2023, the company works with more than 3,000 blood testing labs nationwide (including Quest Diagnostics) and offers in-home services for an extra fee. topic: Ohana Growth Partners Sells its Florida Portfolio

facts.label: Story
facts.value: Ohana Growth Partners Sells its Florida Portfolio

facts.label: Article
facts.value: Ohana Growth Partners (OGP), one of the largest franchisees of Planet Fitness , announced the sale of its portfolio in the Sunshine State to Gulf Coast Fitness Management (GFCM). The sale includes seven properties, totaling nearly 134,000 square feet. Planet Fitness members can continue to expect the same high-value and Judgement Free experience they’ve enjoyed with best-in-class strength and cardio equipment and free fitness training included in all memberships, and more. “We’re proud of the strength of our Florida clubs and the team that built them, and we’re excited about a compelling opportunity that we believe is positive for our team members, our members and the communities we serve,” said Justin Drummond , the president of OGP. “The interest in these clubs is a great reflection of the strength of the business and the team that has built it.” “This acquisition was aligned with our strategic growth goals, and we’re thrilled to have initially joined the Florida community,” said Ian McClure, the CEO of GFCM, noting that GCFM is actively pursuing Planet Fitness development opportunities along Florida’s Gulf Coast. In addition to owning and operating the seven OGP clubs, GCFM has developing rights for 20 Planet Fitness clubs along Florida’s west coast from St. Petersburg to Naples. It also was granted development rights for three new clubs in Broward and Palm Beach County.

en.headline: Ohana Growth Partners Sells its Florida Portfolio

topic: Die Fitnesskampagne „United let’s move.“ bricht alle Rekorde

facts.label: Story
facts.value: Die Fitnesskampagne „United let’s move.“ bricht alle Rekorde

facts.label: Article
facts.value: Die Fitnesskampagne „United let’s move.“ bricht alle Rekorde und verzeichnet über 166.000 Trainingsbesuche von Nicht-Mitgliedern Bei der diesjährigen Fitnesskampagne „United let’s move.“ gab es eine Rekordbeteiligung: 1.950 Fitness- und Gesundheitsanlagen aus Deutschland und Österreich sowie rund 7.500 weitere Partnerstudios der Aggregatoren beteiligten sich an der Aktionswoche. Dabei stieg die Zahl der Trainingsbesuche von Nichtmitgliedern um 41,1 Prozent auf über 166.000. Auch die Politik setzte beim parlamentarischen Workout am Bundestag in Berlin ein Zeichen für mehr Bewegung. Hamburg, 23. November 2026 – Die Fitness- und Gesundheitsbranche setzt ein starkes Zeichen für mehr Bewegung und Prävention: Die jährlich stattfindende Aktionswoche „United let’s move.“ hat das Ziel, Menschen für körperliche Aktivität, Fitnesstraining und einen gesunden Lebensstil zu begeistern. Im Rahmen der Europäischen Woche des Sports, die vom 23. bis zum 30. September 2026 stattfand, wurden in den teilnehmenden Fitnessstudios über 3,1 Millionen Trainingsbesuche verzeichnet. Besonders erfreulich: Mehr als 166.000 Trainingsbesuche entfielen auf Menschen ohne bestehende Studiomitgliedschaft. Das entspricht einer Steigerung von 41,1 Prozent gegenüber dem Vorjahr. Auch die Beteiligung der Fitness- und Gesundheitsanlagen erreichte einen neuen Höchststand.

en.headline: Die Fitnesskampagne „United let’s move.“ bricht alle Rekorde

de.headline: Die Fitnesskampagne „United let’s move.“ bricht alle Rekorde
